title: Compound Words
rule: A compound word is two smaller words put together, like sun and set make sunset. Divide it between the two words.
trickText: Look for two smaller words that are real words on their own. If both parts are words, it is a compound word. Divide between them.
say: Today's case: compound words. A compound word is two words joined together, like sun and set make sunset. We divide a compound word between the two words.

activities.instruction: Tap the space between the two words to divide the compound word.

activities.instruction: Is it a compound word: two real words joined together?

categories.label: Not a compound word
categories.why: The parts are not both real words.

items.why: sun and set are both words, so sunset is a compound word.
pop and corn are both words.
note and book are both words.
rain and bow are both words.
back and pack are both words.
cup and cake are both words.
nap is a word, but kin is not part of the meaning. It is not a compound word.
bas is not a word, so basket is not a compound word.
kit and ten are words, but kitten does not mean kit plus ten. It is not a compound word.
rab and bit are not both words that make rabbit.
pic and nic are not both words.
in and sect do not make the meaning of insect.

example.answer: s u n | s e t
example.say: Look at sunset. It is two words, sun and set. I divide between them.
